primaryTextRead.text: The sons of Ezrah: Jether, Mered, Epher, and Jalon; and Mered’s wife bore Miriam, Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.

wikipediaRead.title: List of minor Hebrew Bible figures, A–K
wikipediaRead.locator: A–K list, “Ezrah” subsection, line 2656; identifies Epher as a son of Ezrah and cites 1 Chronicles 4:17. Standalone Epher article lines 106–108 concerns a son of Midian, a different person.
wikipediaRead.supportParaphraseJa: 一覧のエズラ節はエフェルをジェテル、メレド、ヤロンとともにエズラの子として1歴代誌4:17へ結び付ける。
wikipediaRead.identityAssessment: Exact shared-section identification; standalone Epher article is a different person (son of Midian).
